chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Khalid from Abu al-Jahm from Abu Khadijah said:

We were with Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) and we had descended the road. He said, 'You see this mountain, Thafil? Indeed, Yazid ibn Mu'awiya (may Allah curse themboth — when he returned from his Hajj, departing for Syria, he then began to say: "When we leave Thafil to the right, we will not return after it for our years for Hajj and Umrah as long as we live." Then Allah caused him to die before his appointed time.'

key_terms.ثَافِلٌ: Mount Thafil, a mountain near Mecca
key_terms.فَأَمَاتَهُ اللَّهُ: Then Allah caused him to die
key_terms.لَعَنَهُمَا اللَّهُ: May Allah curse them both (often referring to Yazid and his father Mu'awiya)
key_terms.يَزِيدُ بْنُ مُُعَاوِيَةَ: Yazid ibn Mu'awiya, the Umayyad Caliph

ai.seo_question: What did Yazid ibn Mu'awiya say about Mount Thafil and his pilgrimage, according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) identifies Mount Thafil as the site where Umayyad Caliph Yazid ibn Mu'awiya, upon returning from his Hajj, declared he would not return for Hajj or Umrah for the rest of his life. The Imam concludes that Allah caused him to die before his appointed time, thereby fulfilling the condition of his vow or ending his state of pilgrimage, illustrating the divine power over the fate of rulers and the validity of their vows.
